name: – Stéphanie Yon-Courtin – After § 13 – Am 3
title: REPORT on competition policy – annual report 2025
part_text: 13a. Highlights the fact that corporate profits have been important contemporary drivers of inflation; stresses that profit-driven inflation, or greedflation, should be met with appropriate interventions, such as windfall taxes, price controls or antitrust proceedings, in order to mitigate its socially harmful impact on living costs; calls on the Member States and the Commission to immediately introduce permanent windfall profit taxes to combat profit-driven inflation in all sectors and to redistribute windfall profits to low-income households;
